title: The Stick That Caught a Thief
topic: The King's Sticks: a thief who catches himself
mechanism: Ordinary sticks plus a fake threat: only the guilty guard believes his stick will grow, so only he shortens it, and the one short stick names him.

beats.hook: Empty velvet necklace cushion in a locked, candlelit throne room; bolted door slams; twelve guards' faces
beats.story: The King locks the twelve guards in and hands out identical sticks with the wizard threat
beats.rise: The grinning guard mocks the King ('measure mine first') and hides his stick all night; others fret and measure
beats.twist: Morning line-up: eleven sticks match, one is shorter, and the grinning guard blurts 'it was supposed to grow'
beats.mechanism: Cut to the palace woodshed: a crate stamped WOODSHED full of the same sticks; a dial/label NO MAGIC; the knife and wood shavings in the corner labelled ONE INCH; a tile ruler showing the short stick
beats.ending: The King holds out his hand; the necklace drops into it. Final line: the thief measured himself.

seed.what: The grinning guard (gold tooth, red sash) and his stick, close on him laughing
